image: Underside of an engine bay with a wet streak and drips along a fuel line, close to the exhaust manifold.

image: Instrument cluster showing 182,000 miles on the odometer.

image: Small coin-sized Bluetooth tracker held in a hand, next to the wheel well of a car.

image: VIN plate riveted to the dashboard, seen through the windshield.

image: Rear bumper with an old dent: faded paint, rust at the edges of the dent.

image: Diesel pickup on a lift, with the diesel particulate filter (DPF) section of the exhaust visible.

image: Dashboard with the airbag (SRS) warning light lit.
